**We graduate students for life**

The Language Center teaches Arabic and English communication skills to all university students and Arabic courses to non-native speakers and serves the local and global communities by holding local and international exams, and by holding training courses for students and teachers in English and Arabic.

Our mission is to provide first-class education and services and support the linguistic, intellectual, social, and cultural development of our students through talented and professional instructors, emerging in the native community and through a positive and supportive learning environment. We also provide access to opportunities that enable students to develop the knowledge and skills needed to achieve their goals.
